description: The drxinfra.ru security self-assessment of a Directum RX installation: 22 weighted questions on backups, passwords, network exposure, updates, TLS, accounts, logs and more, from critical to low. Call without answers to get the questions with weights, hints and fixes; ask the user, then call with answers to get the score out of 100, the zone (red, yellow, green) and the gaps to close first, counted exactly as on drxinfra.ru/security-check.html, with a link that opens the same answers there.

answers.description: Answers by question id: y = yes, p = partly, n = no, u = don't know. Unanswered questions do not count.

name: security_self_check
title: Directum RX security self-assessment
